label: HSK3d — 天, and the four seasons that needed it
_comment: 春 夏 秋 冬 were left stranded because every natural sentence uses 春天/夏天, and 天 existed only inside 今天/明天/每天 — never as a word in its own right. The same compound-versus-standalone miss as 到/饭/学 in batch b. Adding 天 unlocks all four.

sentences.pinyin: chūn tiān yǒu hěn duō huā
sentences.gloss_en: There are lots of flowers in spring.

sentences.pinyin: qiū tiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo
sentences.gloss_en: The weather in autumn is good.

sentences.pinyin: yīn tiān wǒ bù xiǎng chūqù
sentences.gloss_en: On an overcast day I don't want to go out.
